There might be a subtle discrepancy where one driver skips the creator-based deletion.

value.text: I notice the reaction table has no FK constraint at all—only memo_share has cascade on memo_id. Reactions tied to a deleted user's memos get removed via content_id matching "memos/<uid>", while reactions the user authored elsewhere get removed by creator_id, so I want to verify this against the delete tests and API layer.

value.text: That confirms it — the reaction table has no foreign key at all, so there's no DB cascade there; the only cascade in the schema is memo_share.memo_id referencing memo(id).
